# Blockframes

Loads an SVG of wireframe blocks, colors them from a palette, and animates them with GSAP.

## What's here

- `Blockframes.js` - the main class; `await load()` before using anything else
- `Painter.js` - colors a block by its class name
- `Builder.js` - clones and places blocks
- `Animator.js` - GSAP animation presets
- `Architect.js` - generates a grid with no matching neighbors
- `atoms/`, `molecules/`, `organisms/`, `templates/`, `layouts/` - painters grouped by size. The atoms and molecules are empty placeholders so far; the templates are filled in.

## How it connects

- `choreography/molecules/process-motion/blockframes-grid.js` loads `Blockframes.js` and fills a grid of blocks.
- That belongs to the process section, which no page renders right now.
- Needs GSAP on the page and fetches SVG.js from a CDN.
